exposure: Uterine abnormalities (leiomyoma, adenomyosis, thickened endometrial strip, polyps)
cohort: Three hundred patients who underwent endometrial ablation between January 2006 and May 2013 at two large academic medical centers
finding: A history of dysmenorrhea and tubal sterilization were associated with an increased risk of developing pain after endometrial ablation, while a history of cesarean delivery and uterine abnormalities were associated with an increased risk of hysterectomy.
